ar.label: 돌격소총
ar.desc: Assault rifles are well-balanced fully automatic weapons with a moderate amount of recoil, most useful at medium range.

hdg.label: 권총
hdg.desc: Pistols are accurate, easy to handle sidearms that deal extra damage to injured enemies.

hdgstg.label: 보조무기 산탄총
hdgstg.desc: The ultimate close quarters weapon, shotguns provide extremely high damage at close range.

lmg.label: 경기관총
lmg.bonus: DMG to Target Out of Cover
lmg.desc: Light machine guns are high-powered fully automatic weapons with large capacity magazines, but which require some time to stabilize when firing.

mmr.label: 저격소총
mmr.desc: Marksman rifles are high-powered precision rifles with extra headshot damage, designed for long range combat.

smg.label: 기관단총
smg.desc: Submachine guns are stable, high mobility weapons with extra critical hit chance but short range.

stg.label: 산탄총
stg.desc: The ultimate close quarters weapon, shotguns provide extremely high damage at close range.
